messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for service=\"model-catalog\" severity=P1 — pager:INC-20260314-7f9a https://pager.example/INC-20260314-7f9a
PagerDuty: Incident INC-20260314-7f9a assigned to Alex R (on-call) — escalation policy: eng-oncall
Alex R: acked — looking into it now. seeing a flood of catalog validation errors in the last 2 mins.
Priya S: noticed runtime alert: tokenizer-mismatch exceptions spiking (tokenizer_length=0 errors) and a handful of 500s from the text-generation route. might be a bad tokenizer config on the new model rev.
Jamie L: can you paste the catalog rev id? I can try to pin the default back to previous revision if we confirm.
Alex R: rev id promoted ~10:42 UTC is rev:2026-03-14-rc3b. current default points to that. previous stable is rev:2026-03-07-stable.
Priya S: logs show the tokenizer name on rev:2026-03-14-rc3b is \"tokenizer-v2-dedupe\" but the model binary expects \"tokenizer-v1\" — mismatch at encode step, results in empty prompt tokens -> generator returns empty output or errors.
Alex R: ok immediate mitigation: rollback default in catalog to previous revision. running admin CLI:
```
# pin default model revision back to stable
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://admin.redwood.internal/catalog/defaults \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-1","revision":"rev:2026-03-07-stable"}'
```
Jamie L: if you want a faster toggle, you can use the routing override endpoint to route traffic to the stable variant until catalog promotion is fixed.
```
POST /admin/routes/overrides
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "model": "text-embed-1", "revision": "rev:2026-03-07-stable", "expires_in": 600 }
```
Alex R: executed the catalog pin — admin returned 200 OK, new default revision = rev:2026-03-07-stable. applying for all regions.
Priya S: monitoring: error rate dropping on text-generation from 8% -> 1.2% in the last 3 mins. latency stable. Support has flagged 4 customer tickets complaining about truncated responses (TCK-5812, TCK-5817, TCK-5821, TCK-5824).
Support Bot: created internal incident ticket INF-9092 and linked customer cases: acct-742, acct-501, acct-223. Notified CS triage.
Jamie L: good containment. next step: prevent auto-promote flows from staging to default until we validate tokenizer compatibility. looks like the onboarding script didn't set tokenizer_id properly for this revision.
Alex R: I've disabled the auto-promotion job for model-catalog for now. command: `systemctl stop model-catalog-autopromote` (running on control plane).
Priya S: can we get a quick diff of the tokenizer config between the two revs? I suspect a config key `vocab_hash` or `normalize` changed.
Jamie L: grabbing diff...
```
--- rev:2026-03-07-stable/config.json
+++ rev:2026-03-14-rc3b/config.json
@@
- "tokenizer": "tokenizer-v1",
+ "tokenizer": "tokenizer-v2-dedupe",
+ "tokenizer_options": { "normalize": true }
```
Jamie L: yep, config differs. onboarding pipeline omitted a migration step to update model's tokenization layer for v2. that caused the runtime to feed tokens incompatible with the model's embedder.
Alex R: action items while we keep default pinned: 1) rollback pipeline change for rev:2026-03-14-rc3b (Jamie) 2) run tokenization compatibility test harness on new rev (Priya) 3) customer comms + support replies (Support) 4) follow-up postmortem (Priya). I'll stay on until stabilization.
Priya S: I'll own the postmortem and run the compatibility tests. starting a quick smoke test now against a staging copy of rev:2026-03-14-rc3b with tokenizer-v1 forced to see failure modes.
Jamie L: re: hotfix, we can either rebuild rev:rc3b with tokenizer-v1 baked in or add a migration shim in the runtime to map tokenizer-v2 tokens to v1 encoding. rebuilding takes longer but cheaper to be correct.
Alex R: decision: rebuild rev:2026-03-14 into rev:2026-03-14-fixed and run full evals; until then keep default pinned. inform CS.
Support Bot: drafted customer note: "We're aware of an issue affecting generation for a subset of requests after a model revision promotion. We've pinned to a previous stable revision and responses are recovering. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA for a fixed model." Please review.
Priya S: timeline: initial page 10:42 UTC, rollback executed 10:45 UTC, error rate largely recovered by 10:49 UTC. I'm estimating RCA & rebuild to take ~6-8 hours.
Alex R: thanks — marking incident as contained. leaving the pager acknowledged. I'll handoff to Priya for postmortem and follow-ups. @PagerDuty please close the on-call incident when you have the final notes. :thumbsup:
PagerDuty: Incident INC-20260314-7f9a acknowledged -> resolved by user Alex R. Closing incident in 10s.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-20260314-7f9a status changed to RESOLVED. Follow-up: set postmortem owner=Priya S, severity=P1, impact=some customers saw truncated/empty responses for ~3–7 mins, mitigation=rollback to rev:2026-03-07-stable.
Alex R: adding retrospective items: add a pre-promotion tokenizer compatibility gate to onboarding, add an automated smoke test that runs tokenization+inference on a representative prompt set, and make auto-promote require a two-person approval for major tokenizer changes.
Priya S: acknowledged, I'll include those in the postmortem and create JIRA INF-9144 for the compatibility gate.
Jamie L: also recommend we add a runtime defensive check that rejects mismatched tokenizer/model pair during startup and refuses to mark a revision as healthy.
Alex R: ok closing thread here. thanks everyone for the quick response. :heart:
